name: REA UI · AI 设计任务

import { Page, Frame, Group, Rect, Ellipse, Text, Vector } from '@rea/design';

    <Frame designId="sidebar-frame" name="左侧导航" className="absolute left-[0px] top-[0px] w-[228px] h-[1024px] bg-[#fafbfc] border-r border-[#e5e7eb]">
      <Text designId="brand-wordmark" name="REA 品牌" className="absolute left-[24px] top-[26px] w-[52px] h-[47px] text-[29px] leading-[47px] font-bold tracking-[-1px] text-[#30343b]">rea</Text>
      <Rect designId="brand-mark" name="品牌蓝色标记" className="absolute left-[74px] top-[51px] w-[5px] h-[5px] bg-[#356af0] rounded-[1px]" />
      <Text designId="brand-description" name="品牌说明" className="absolute left-[88px] top-[37px] w-[112px] h-[18px] text-[11px] leading-[18px] text-[#656d79]">设计工作空间</Text>
      <Frame designId="nav-ai-tasks" name="导航 · AI 设计任务 · 当前" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[104px] w-[204px] h-[42px] bg-[#eaf0ff] rounded-[6px]">
        <Vector designId="nav-ai-icon" name="图标 · 设计任务" className="absolute left-[13px] top-[12px] w-[18px] h-[18px] fill-none stroke-[#356af0] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M12 3H5A2 2 0 0 0 3 5V19A2 2 0 0 0 5 21H19A2 2 0 0 0 21 19V12M17 3 21 7 12 16 8 17 9 13Z" />
        <Text designId="nav-ai-label" name="AI 设计任务" className="absolute left-[43px] top-[10px] w-[144px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] font-semibold text-[#356af0]">AI 设计任务</Text>
      </Frame>
      <Frame designId="nav-projects" name="导航 · 全部项目" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[151px] w-[204px] h-[42px] rounded-[6px]">
        <Vector designId="nav-projects-icon" name="图标 · 项目文件夹" className="absolute left-[13px] top-[12px] w-[18px] h-[18px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M3 6H9L11 8H21V20H3ZM3 6V4H9L11 6H21V8" />
        <Text designId="nav-projects-label" name="全部项目" className="absolute left-[43px] top-[10px] w-[144px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] text-[#656d79]">全部项目</Text>
      </Frame>
      <Frame designId="nav-design-systems" name="导航 · 设计系统" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[198px] w-[204px] h-[42px] rounded-[6px]">
        <Vector designId="nav-systems-icon" name="图标 · 设计系统" className="absolute left-[13px] top-[12px] w-[18px] h-[18px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M12 3 17 11H7ZM3 15H10V22H3ZM20 15A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 20 22A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 20 15" />
        <Text designId="nav-systems-label" name="设计系统" className="absolute left-[43px] top-[10px] w-[144px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] text-[#656d79]">设计系统</Text>
      </Frame>
      <Frame designId="nav-settings" name="导航 · 设置" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[245px] w-[204px] h-[42px] rounded-[6px]">
        <Vector designId="nav-settings-icon" name="图标 · 设置" className="absolute left-[13px] top-[12px] w-[18px] h-[18px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M3 6H9M13 6H21M3 12H15M19 12H21M3 18H5M9 18H21M9 3V9M15 9V15M5 15V21" />
        <Text designId="nav-settings-label" name="设置" className="absolute left-[43px] top-[10px] w-[144px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] text-[#656d79]">设置</Text>
      </Frame>
      <Rect designId="workspace-divider" name="工作空间分隔线" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[944px] w-[204px] h-[1px] bg-[#e5e7eb]" />
      <Text designId="workspace-name" name="本地工作空间" className="absolute left-[24px] top-[962px] w-[180px] h-[20px] text-[12px] leading-[20px] font-medium text-[#30343b]">本地工作空间</Text>
      <Text designId="workspace-description" name="工作空间说明" className="absolute left-[24px] top-[984px] w-[180px] h-[16px] text-[11px] leading-[16px] text-[#656d79]">设计文档保存在本机</Text>
    </Frame>
    <Frame designId="header-frame" name="顶部标题与任务操作" className="absolute left-[228px] top-[0px] w-[1212px] h-[112px] bg-[#ffffff] border-b border-[#e5e7eb]">
      <Text designId="page-title" name="页面标题" className="absolute left-[36px] top-[27px] w-[620px] h-[32px] text-[24px] leading-[32px] font-semibold text-[#30343b]">AI 设计任务</Text>
      <Text designId="page-description" name="页面说明" className="absolute left-[36px] top-[68px] w-[800px] h-[20px] text-[12px] leading-[20px] text-[#656d79]">描述设计需求，关联项目上下文，生成可继续编辑的界面。</Text>
      <Frame designId="new-task-button" name="按钮 · 新建任务" className="absolute left-[1060px] top-[39px] w-[116px] h-[34px] bg-[#356af0] rounded-[5px]">

        <Text designId="new-task-label" name="新建任务" className="absolute left-[36px] top-[7px] w-[68px] h-[20px] text-[12px] leading-[20px] font-medium text-[#ffffff]">新建任务</Text>
      </Frame>
    </Frame>
    <Frame designId="brief-panel" name="设计需求与生成配置" className="absolute left-[264px] top-[144px] w-[1140px] h-[360px] bg-[#ffffff] border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[8px]">

      </Frame>
      <Text designId="system-field-label" name="选择设计系统标签" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[196px] w-[536px] h-[18px] text-[12px] leading-[18px] font-medium text-[#30343b]">选择设计系统</Text>
      <Text designId="project-field-label" name="关联本地项目标签" className="absolute left-[572px] top-[196px] w-[548px] h-[18px] text-[12px] leading-[18px] font-medium text-[#30343b]">关联本地项目</Text>
      <Frame designId="system-selector" name="入口 · 选择或更换设计系统" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[222px] w-[536px] h-[44px] bg-[#ffffff] border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[5px]">
        <Vector designId="system-selector-icon" name="图标 · 当前设计系统" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[14px] w-[16px] h-[16px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M12 3 17 11H7ZM3 15H10V22H3ZM20 15A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 20 22A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 20 15" />
        <Text designId="system-selected-value" name="已选设计系统 · REA UI 本地生成" className="absolute left-[38px] top-[12px] w-[452px] h-[20px] text-[12px] leading-[20px] text-[#30343b]">REA UI 本地生成</Text>
        <Vector designId="system-selector-chevron" name="图标 · 展开设计系统选择" className="absolute left-[508px] top-[16px] w-[12px] h-[12px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M6 9 12 15 18 9" />
      </Frame>
      <Frame designId="project-selector" name="入口 · 关联或更换本地项目" className="absolute left-[572px] top-[222px] w-[548px] h-[44px] bg-[#ffffff] border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[5px]">
        <Vector designId="project-selector-icon" name="图标 · 本地项目文件夹" className="absolute left-[12px] top-[14px] w-[16px] h-[16px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M3 6H9L11 8H21V20H3ZM3 6V4H9L11 6H21V8" />
        <Text designId="project-selected-value" name="已关联项目与本地路径" className="absolute left-[38px] top-[12px] w-[470px] h-[20px] text-[12px] leading-[20px] text-[#30343b]">rea.ui · /path/to/project</Text>
        <Vector designId="project-selector-chevron" name="图标 · 展开本地项目选择" className="absolute left-[520px] top-[16px] w-[12px] h-[12px] fill-none stroke-[#656d79] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M6 9 12 15 18 9" />
      </Frame>
      <Text designId="generation-context-hint" name="生成上下文说明" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[300px] w-[820px] h-[20px] text-[11px] leading-[20px] text-[#656d79]">将使用所选系统的颜色、字体与组件规范，并参考关联项目。</Text>
      <Frame designId="generate-button" name="按钮 · 生成设计" className="absolute left-[990px] top-[294px] w-[130px] h-[34px] bg-[#356af0] rounded-[5px]">

        <Vector designId="generate-button-icon" name="图标 · 开始生成" className="absolute left-[100px] top-[9px] w-[16px] h-[16px] fill-none stroke-[#ffffff] [stroke-width:1.65] [stroke-linecap:round] [stroke-linejoin:round]" viewBox="0 0 24 24" d="M5 12H19M13 6 19 12 13 18" />
      </Frame>
    </Frame>
    <Text designId="recent-tasks-title" name="最近任务标题" className="absolute left-[264px] top-[544px] w-[320px] h-[24px] text-[16px] leading-[24px] font-semibold text-[#30343b]">最近任务</Text>
    <Text designId="recent-tasks-sort" name="任务数量与排序说明" className="absolute left-[1064px] top-[549px] w-[340px] h-[18px] text-[11px] leading-[18px] text-right text-[#656d79]">共 3 个任务 · 按最近更新排序</Text>
    <Frame designId="task-workbench-row" name="最近任务 · AI 设计任务工作台" className="absolute left-[264px] top-[588px] w-[1140px] h-[100px] bg-[#ffffff] border-t border-b border-[#e5e7eb]">
      <Text designId="task-workbench-title" name="任务名称 · AI 设计任务工作台" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[20px] w-[760px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] font-semibold text-[#30343b]">AI 设计任务工作台</Text>
      <Text designId="task-workbench-meta" name="工作台任务关联信息与更新时间" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[51px] w-[840px] h-[18px] text-[11px] leading-[18px] text-[#656d79]">REA UI 本地生成 · rea.ui · 1 个页面 · 今天 14:32</Text>
      <Text designId="task-workbench-status" name="工作台任务状态 · 已完成" className="absolute left-[908px] top-[34px] w-[72px] h-[24px] bg-[#eaf0ff] rounded-[4px] text-[11px] leading-[24px] text-center text-[#356af0]">已完成</Text>
      <Text designId="task-workbench-action" name="按钮 · 打开工作台设计" className="absolute left-[1016px] top-[30px] w-[104px] h-[32px] bg-[#ffffff] border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[4px] text-[12px] leading-[30px] text-center text-[#30343b]">打开设计</Text>
    </Frame>
    <Frame designId="task-projects-row" name="最近任务 · 项目管理列表页" className="absolute left-[264px] top-[688px] w-[1140px] h-[100px] bg-[#ffffff] border-b border-[#e5e7eb]">
      <Text designId="task-projects-title" name="任务名称 · 项目管理列表页" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[20px] w-[760px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] font-semibold text-[#30343b]">项目管理列表页</Text>
      <Text designId="task-projects-meta" name="项目列表任务关联信息与更新时间" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[51px] w-[840px] h-[18px] text-[11px] leading-[18px] text-[#656d79]">REA UI 本地生成 · rea.ui · 2 个页面 · 今天 11:08</Text>
      <Text designId="task-projects-status" name="项目列表任务状态 · 已完成" className="absolute left-[908px] top-[34px] w-[72px] h-[24px] bg-[#eaf0ff] rounded-[4px] text-[11px] leading-[24px] text-center text-[#356af0]">已完成</Text>
      <Text designId="task-projects-action" name="按钮 · 打开项目列表设计" className="absolute left-[1016px] top-[30px] w-[104px] h-[32px] bg-[#ffffff] border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[4px] text-[12px] leading-[30px] text-center text-[#30343b]">打开设计</Text>
    </Frame>
    <Frame designId="task-settings-row" name="最近任务 · 设计系统设置页" className="absolute left-[264px] top-[788px] w-[1140px] h-[100px] bg-[#ffffff] border-b border-[#e5e7eb]">
      <Text designId="task-settings-title" name="任务名称 · 设计系统设置页" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[20px] w-[760px] h-[22px] text-[13px] leading-[22px] font-semibold text-[#30343b]">设计系统设置页</Text>
      <Text designId="task-settings-meta" name="设置页任务关联信息与更新时间" className="absolute left-[20px] top-[51px] w-[840px] h-[18px] text-[11px] leading-[18px] text-[#656d79]">REA UI 本地生成 · 未关联项目 · 昨天 18:46</Text>
      <Text designId="task-settings-status" name="设置页任务状态 · 草稿" className="absolute left-[908px] top-[34px] w-[72px] h-[24px] bg-[#f1f3f6] rounded-[4px] text-[11px] leading-[24px] text-center text-[#656d79]">草稿</Text>
      <Text designId="task-settings-action" name="按钮 · 继续编辑设置页任务" className="absolute left-[1016px] top-[30px] w-[104px] h-[32px] bg-[#ffffff] border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[4px] text-[12px] leading-[30px] text-center text-[#30343b]">继续编辑</Text>
    </Frame>
    <Text designId="page-footer" name="页脚 · 本地设计说明" className="absolute left-[264px] top-[956px] w-[1140px] h-[40px] border-t border-[#e5e7eb] text-[11px] leading-[40px] text-[#656d79]">设计文档保存在本地，可随时回到编辑器继续调整。</Text>
  </Frame>

summary: 1440×1024 单页工作台，64 个可编辑图层，包含需求输入、设计系统选择、本地项目关联和三条最近任务。
